# atlantio

Read, write and manipulate
[Atlantis](https://research.csiro.au/atlantis/) model inputs and
outputs. `atlantio` provides an S7 class `Atlantis` that represents an
Atlantis model, functions to read and write Atlantis files, and methods
to extract diet tables, food webs and time series from a model.

## Installation

`atlantio` is not on CRAN yet. Install the development version from
GitHub with [pak](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("inSileco/atlantio")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(atlantio)
mod <- new_atlantis() |>
  atlantis_load_files(c(
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "output.nc"),
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "outputBiomIndx.txt"),
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "outputBoxBiomass.txt")
  ))
mod

# ── Atlantis Model ──
# 
# ── Data availability: 
# ✖ Geometry (BGM)
# ✖ Run file
# ✖ Biology parameters
# ✖ Group file
# ✔ Main output
# ✖ Diet data
# ✖ Detailed diet data
# ✔ Biomass (system-wide)
# ✔ Biomass (per box)
# ✖ Biomass (per age)
# 
# ── Main output details: 
# • 139 variables
# • 74 time steps
```

See the package vignettes for details on reading models, listing
parameters and calibration workflows.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Atlantis()`](Atlantis.md) : Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container
- [`aggregate_time_series()`](aggregate_time_series.md) : Aggregate
  age-structured tracers over boxes and layers
- [`apply_parameters()`](apply_parameters.md) : Apply a set of
  calibrated values to an Atlantis object
- [`atlantis_examples()`](atlantis_examples.md) : Helper function to
  quickly access example files.
- [`atlantis_load_files()`](atlantis_load_files.md) : Load Atlantis
  files into model object
- [`atlantis_supported_versions`](atlantis_supported_versions.md) :
  Atlantis versions supported by atlantio
- [`check_init()`](check_init.md) : Check an Atlantis initial-conditions
  file
- [`check_prm()`](check_prm.md) : Check Atlantis parameter files
- [`check_run()`](check_run.md) : Check that an Atlantis run completed
- [`compare_prm()`](compare_prm.md) : Compare two Atlantis parameter
  files
- [`create_diet_table()`](create_diet_table.md) : Create a diet table
- [`create_foodweb()`](create_foodweb.md) : Create a food web
- [`create_time_series()`](create_time_series.md) : Create time series
  from the main output
- [`create_time_series_biomass()`](create_time_series_biomass.md) :
  Create biomass time series
- [`generate_calibration_table()`](generate_calibration_table.md) :
  Generate a calibration table
- [`generate_file()`](generate_file.md) : Generate parameter files
- [`get_biomass_by_type()`](get_biomass_by_type.md) : Extract biomass
  data by aggregation type
- [`input_files`](input_files.md) : Input files
- [`inverse_transform_parameter_value()`](inverse_transform_parameter_value.md)
  : Map a parameter value from the file scale back to the calibration
  scale
- [`list_atlantis_parameters()`](list_atlantis_parameters.md) : List
  Atlantis parameters for a given Atlantis version
- [`new_atlantis()`](new_atlantis.md) : Create new Atlantis model object
- [`parameters_hints`](parameters_hints.md) : Parameter Hints for
  Atlantis Model Configuration
- [`read_atlantis_files()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_bgm()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_nc()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_group_file()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_prm_files()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_txt_files()`](read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_xml()`](read_atlantis_files.md) : Read Atlantis inputs and
  outputs files
- [`read_biomass_index()`](read_biomass_index.md) : Read the biomass of
  the living groups from the Atlantis biomass index
- [`read_calibration_runs()`](read_calibration_runs.md) : Read the
  parameter values of calibration runs
- [`read_prm()`](read_prm.md) [`write_prm()`](read_prm.md) : Parse .prm
  file contents into structured list
- [`score_table()`](score_table.md) [`compute_score()`](score_table.md)
  : Calibration objective: deviation from the initial state
- [`set_init_values()`](set_init_values.md) : Set the values of a
  variable of an Atlantis initial-conditions file
- [`summarise_calibration()`](summarise_calibration.md) : Summarise the
  parameter values of a calibration
- [`transform_parameter_value()`](transform_parameter_value.md) :
  Transform a parameter value
- [`window_values()`](window_values.md) : Values of a series scored over
  the last years of a run
- [`write_parameter_folder()`](write_parameter_folder.md) : Write a
  complete Atlantis parameter folder
